title: The Princess Who Saved the Royal Line

request.style: English, female vocal, solo with soft choir, Celtic harp, fiddle, bodhran, flute, ethereal, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When Athaliah saw her son was dead
She rose up to destroy the royal line
The whole royal family fell under her hand
Seeking power, she did not spare a single son

[Chorus]
But Jehosheba took the young child away
She stole him from among the dying sons
She hid him and his nurse in a bedroom
Out of Athaliah's sight, safe from the blade

[Verse]
He remained hidden with her in the house of the LORD
For six long years while Athaliah reigned
Jehoiada the priest kept the secret close
Preserving the seed of David in the temple's shadow

[Chorus]
But Jehosheba took the young child away
She stole him from among the dying sons
She hid him and his nurse in a bedroom
Out of Athaliah's sight, safe from the blade

[Bridge]
The daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah
Cried out for the child when death surrounded them all
In the house of God, the lineage was kept
From the wrath of the queen who sought to rule alone

[Chorus]
But Jehosheba took the young child away
She stole him from among the dying sons
She hid him and his nurse in a bedroom
Out of Athaliah's sight, safe from the blade

[Outro]
The royal line was saved by her courage
David's throne remained for the coming days
